candidates.topic: Last Quarter Moon in Cancer — Five Planets Retrograde
candidates.teaser: The Moon is in Cancer right now — and with five planets retrograde at once, this isn't just emotional. It's a reckoning.
candidates.video_title: Last Quarter Moon in Cancer — 5 Planets Retrograde
candidates.video_description: The Last Quarter Moon in Cancer on October 4 lands in the middle of a five-planet retrograde storm. Emotional release isn't optional right now — it's the whole assignment.
candidates.script: Five planets are retrograde right now — and the Moon just moved into Cancer, the most emotionally raw sign in the zodiac. This Last Quarter Moon is forcing a release. Not a gentle one. Saturn retrograde in Aries is making you question authority. Venus retrograde in Scorpio is pulling old desires back to the surface. And the Cancer Moon is making sure you actually feel all of it. So what's breaking down for you right now?

candidates.topic: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio — What It's Really Doing
candidates.teaser: Venus retrograde in Scorpio isn't about romance. It's about what you've been pretending not to want.
candidates.video_title: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio — The Truth You've Been Avoiding
candidates.video_description: Venus retrograde in Scorpio at 8.5° is one of the rarest and most intense placements in astrology. It doesn't soften desire — it exposes it.
candidates.script: Venus retrograde in Scorpio doesn't bring your ex back. It brings back the version of you that settled. Right now, Venus is at 8.5° Scorpio — and retrograde means it's digging inward, not outward. Scorpio doesn't do surface-level desire. It wants obsession, depth, transformation. This retrograde is asking: what have you been pretending is enough? The answer is already there. You just haven't said it out loud yet.

candidates.topic: Mercury in Scorpio — Before the Retrograde
candidates.teaser: Mercury just entered Scorpio — and it goes retrograde in exactly 20 days. What you say right now will matter more than you think.
candidates.video_title: Mercury in Scorpio — 20 Days Before It Goes Retrograde
candidates.video_description: Mercury is at 5.5° Scorpio and heading toward its retrograde shadow on October 24. The things you say — or don't say — in this window have a long shelf life.
candidates.script: Mercury isn't retrograde yet — but it goes retrograde on October 24th, and right now it's sitting at 5.5° Scorpio. That means every conversation you're having this week is laying groundwork for what gets revisited, misunderstood, or exposed next month. Scorpio doesn't forget. Mercury in Scorpio spots the thing people aren't saying. So whatever you're dancing around right now? Say it clearly — or Mercury retrograde will say it for you.

candidates.topic: Jupiter in Leo — The Planet of Expansion in the Sign of Performance
candidates.teaser: Jupiter is in Leo right now — and in astrology, that combination is basically a spotlight looking for someone to land on.
candidates.video_title: Jupiter in Leo — Who Gets the Spotlight?
candidates.video_description: Jupiter expands whatever it touches. In Leo, it expands visibility, creativity, and ego — for better or worse. Here's who benefits most and who needs to watch their step.
candidates.script: Jupiter in Leo is one of the loudest placements in astrology — and it's happening right now. Jupiter expands whatever it touches, and Leo wants to be seen. This combination rewards people who show up boldly, create publicly, and stop apologizing for taking up space. But here's the twist: Jupiter in Leo also inflates the ego. The ones who rise aren't the loudest. They're the ones who actually deliver. Are you performing — or are you producing?

candidates.topic: The Astrological 3rd House — The House Nobody Talks About
candidates.teaser: Everyone knows their Sun sign. Almost nobody looks at their 3rd house — and it might explain more about your mind than anything else in your chart.
candidates.video_title: The 3rd House — The Most Underrated Spot in Your Chart
candidates.video_description: The 3rd house rules your mind, your communication style, your early environment, and how you process the world around you. It's the house that explains why two people with the same Sun sign think completely differently.
candidates.script: Your 3rd house is the most underrated placement in your entire chart — and almost nobody checks it. This house rules how your mind actually works: not how smart you are, but how you think, talk, argue, and process information. It also rules your siblings, your early neighborhood, and the mental patterns you formed before age twelve. The sign on your 3rd house cusp explains why you communicate the way you do — even when it confuses everyone around you. What sign rules yours?
